fieldData.full-article-text:
The Olympia Betanet and Olympia Mainnet will have the capability to create custom fixed supply tokens, and the betanet faucet will distribute a selection of pre-made tokens other than XRD. 

However, for the Olympia Betanet, this functionality will not be available in the Desktop Wallet, and there will be no endpoints supported for this in the JSON-RPC API. Therefore while possible, it is likely only advanced developers would have the technical capability to craft the low level transactions required to create a token prior to the API supporting this. 

For the Olympia Mainnet, archive nodes are likely to support token creation via JSON-RPC API.

fieldData.name: Is it possible to create new tokens on Olympia Betanet and Olympia Mainnet?
